item.title: Epic Games lays off more than 1,000 amid slowing Fortnite engagement
item.description: Fortnite publisher Epic Games said Tuesday it is laying off 1,000 employees to save money as it grapples with industry-wide and company-specific challenges. The North Carolina video game publisher said in a memo to employees that the job cuts are not related to AI. Rather, they stem from industry-wide challenges such as slower growth, weaker spending, and tougher cost economics. item.title: Crews battle fast-growing wildfire in windy Southern California that's forced some to evacuate
item.description: Crews are battling a smoky and fast-growing wildfire in windy Southern California that has forced some residents to evacuate and a community college to temporarily close its doors. The Springs Fire broke out Friday morning and by the evening had grown to about 6.5 square miles. Fire crews are starting to contain it. item.description: One religious brotherhood’s refusal to include women in its Holy Week procession has made front-page news in Spain.
